rows.title: Impact of Coffee Consumption on Fructose-Related Metabolic Alterations: Potential Mechanisms and Implications for Metabolic Diseases.
rows.evidence_boundary: The coffee–fructose literature combines mechanistic, animal, and observational evidence; preparation method, dose, dietary context, and residual confounding limit causal conclusions.

rows.title: Reprogramming brain bioenergetics in depression: an integrative framework linking creatine, branched-chain amino acids, and exercise to neuroplasticity, cognitive function, and depression-related outcomes.
rows.evidence_boundary: The framework combines creatine, BCAAs, and exercise, so any proposed benefit cannot be attributed to a single component; much of the rationale remains mechanistic or adjunctive.

rows.title: Betaine as a regulator of metabolism, epigenetics, and cellular osmoprotection: therapeutic implications in cardiometabolic and renal diseases.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review spans nutritional, mechanistic, and clinical contexts with varying betaine exposures and outcomes; broad pathway effects do not establish disease-specific supplementation efficacy.

rows.title: Gut microbiota-derived TMA/TMAO and IRAK4 signaling in type 2 diabetes: Current evidence, knowledge gaps and future therapeutic opportunities.
rows.evidence_boundary: Direct mechanistic linkage among TMA/TMAO, IRAK4, and type 2 diabetes remains limited and much of the evidence is preclinical; intervention claims are premature.

rows.title: Medicinal Value of Camellia sinensis Bioactive Components: Focus on Theaflavins and Tea Polysaccharides.
rows.evidence_boundary: The review covers multiple tea constituents and diverse preclinical and clinical endpoints; isolated compounds, extracts, beverages, and doses are not interchangeable.
